description: Use this when a visitor asks how often a ride breaks down or which rides at a park are least reliable. Returns 30-day uptime percentage, outages per day, and average and longest outage, least reliable first.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.

ride_id.description: Optional ride ID to return one ride only.

name: parky_get_ride_reliability
title: Get ride reliability
